---
name: New site support / broken selectors
about: A chat site's button doesn't show up, or shows up in the wrong place
title: ""
labels: site-support
---

**Which site, and which URL pattern?**
e.g. https://chat.example.com/*

**What's happening?**
e.g. "No button appears under answers", "Button appears but the wrong text gets analyzed", "Button appears twice".

**Can you paste the outer HTML of one answer?**
In DevTools, right-click the answer element → Inspect → right-click the highlighted node in the Elements panel → Copy → Copy outerHTML, then paste it here. This is the single most useful thing for fixing a selector.

**Do you need to be signed in to use this site?**
Yes / No — this affects whether a maintainer can reproduce it directly.
